simulation_time_assumption.note: Based on timestamps visible in the supplied NASA animation; verify against the matching NASA timestamp list.

mapping.min_max_definition: 1st and 99th percentiles of accepted visible pixels
mapping.warning: The supplied movie is a composited globe visualization. The NASA colorbar represents both color and opacity transfer functions. Thus matched pixel colors can be altered by blending with the Earth surface; these are visible-rendering estimates, not exact global CO2 measurements.
